alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 7 at 5:46AM PST until November 7 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog. Some
locations will see visibility values down to 200 feet at times.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter,
Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore, and Visalia - Porterville - Reedley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
